findings.title: schema_version bump to 3 is not guarded by any test
findings.evidence: test/test_workbench_layout_schema.py:99-100 asserts schema_version >= 2; schemas/workbench-layout.schema.json minimum 2; reverting both layouts to 2 passes all tests
findings.consequence: Dropping the bump the migration ruling (class 4) requires would go undetected; limited harm because useWorkbenchLayouts re-validates stored slot ids

findings.title: No mechanical check for R03 (slot id never equals a panel id) or R05 (pre-migration localStorage loads defaults)
findings.evidence: Diff adds only renamed literals to test_workbench_layout_schema.py; no test loads a v2-shaped stored state; 7 vitest tests do not cover storage
findings.consequence: A future layout could reintroduce a slot id equal to a panel id without any check failing; R05 rests on code reading only
findings.minimal_fix: Add a pytest asserting slot_ids and panel_ids are disjoint per layout, and optionally a vitest on loadStoredState(3) with only a v2 key present

findings.title: workbench-layout.schema.json prose still describes schema_version 2
findings.evidence: schemas/workbench-layout.schema.json description 'schema_version 2: eligibility moved ...' and version description 'Bumped from 1'; file untouched, outside declared deliverables
findings.consequence: Schema documentation disagrees with the shipped version 3 files; validation unaffected
findings.minimal_fix: Update the description in a follow-up, or accept as out of scope
